title: Amazing experience
text: I can really recommend this. We went with a group of friends and truly had a amazing experience!
author: K2709LProyd

title: Great Experience
text: The Sherry guide was so knowledgeable and imparted the information in a very relaxed style. The Sherry and accompaniments were all really nice too.
author: Ray_H

title: Great experience
text: This is a fantastic experience! Antonio is very knowledge on sherrys and makes the experience very personable. Loved every minute of it and learned so much. Great food pairings as well.
author: Joshua_M

title: Interesting and a good balance of information and tastings
text: Lovely location, elegant.  Nice small group and good set up to make it easy to chat to other people. It was interesting and a good balance of information, tasting and nibbles to complement the sherry. The 90 minutes flew by! Would recommend.
author: Suzanne_P

title: Educational adventure
text: We enjoyed learning about the different types of sherry wines, the grapes, the process in making the wines, the different regions that produce sherry, and the food pairings with the different tastes.
author: Mark_H

title: Great tasting
text: Incredibly informative tasting that really helped me develop a better understanding of sherry. Also very helpful in knowing how to best drink it.
author: Christopher_T

title: Sherry tasting in Seville
text: Israel was passionate about the subject and led a fantastic sherry wine tasting as an external provider at our hotel in central Seville. Sadly the acoustics in the room made it difficult but not impossible. Not Israel’s problem - the problem was the room. We all learned a lot and were taken on a journey through sherry production of different types - great experience.
author: christopherrF7344CO

title: Very professional...
text: Very experienced professional. Conducted the tasting with mastery. Excellent wines. Cozy place.
author: Edson_C

title: Great introduction to sherry
text:
The host had an exceptional knowledge of sherry and its production. Very interesting and informative. Good quantity of sampling and great pairing of olives, cheese etc.
Very well worth doing.
author: Dreamer01602954005

title: Great experience and value for money.
text: Our host Fabio was extremely knowledgeable about the Sherry making process and the types of sherry we were tasting. He paired them with some meats, olives and cheese.
author: dehbolton
